results.name: Transport vs Data Freshness: Preserves last valid snapshot on malformed/out-of-order responses and marks repeated old snapshots stale on HTTP 200
results.details: Verified HTTP 200 invalid JSON/schema/out-of-order contact tracking, transport vs envelope vs worker source vs static project metadata freshness separation, and terminal worker exclusion.

results.name: Connection Handling: Aborts hung requests on timeout, prevents overlapping polls, and ignores late responses after mode/endpoint reset
results.details: Verified 50ms AbortSignal timeout on hung requests, skipped_in_flight overlap guard, and ignored_stale_generation on late responses.

results.details: Verified dispatch capability/connection checks, Alice->Bob rejection, contradictory ok:true+commandAccepted:false / errorCode:DELIVERY_FAILED rejection, and single-attempt UNCERTAIN_WRITE_TIMEOUT.

results.name: Mounted App Continuous Polling: Executes 5+ consecutive successful polls via fake timers, backs off on failures, recovers, and stops on unmount
results.details: Verified 5 consecutive successful polls on mounted App, 1.5x/2.25x backoff on failures, initial HTTP 200 invalid JSON -> network failure -> valid recovery reachability accuracy, and full stop on unmount.

results.details: Verified complete endpoint isolation across A → B and A → B → A while reads and commands are pending.

results.details: Verified mounted DOM archive + undo, repeated priority mutations, collapsible sidebar, and Live Mode command contradiction/recipient-mismatch rejections.
